description: Answers 'give me this stock's bars ready to load into my backtester.' Give a symbol and a framework (backtrader, backtesting_py, vectorbt, zipline, lean, nautilus, freqtrade or qlib); optionally start and end. Returns files (path, encoding, content) plus load_code - write each file at its path, then run load_code. Bars are clipped to as_of; start defaults to 365 days before end. Free keys get the last 12 months; full history with a FinzData plan.

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

name: backtest_export
title: Export bars for a backtester
